# tdd-guru

Enforces current Test-Driven Development (TDD) best practices across programming languages and scripts, including red-green-refactor workflow, deterministic test design, test pyramid balance, and quality signals beyond coverage. Use when users ask about TDD workflow, test strategy, flaky test remediation, unit/integration/end-to-end balance, contract testing, or improving test effectiveness in CI. Do NOT use for unrelated non-testing prompts or language-only questions without testing intent.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 1.0.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r tdd-guru ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r tdd-guru .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `references/language-and-tooling-map.md`
- `references/tdd-workflow-playbook.md`
- `references/web-verified-baseline.md`
